import Hilbert193.Continuity

/-! Independent scope/axiom audit for the existing Cambie–Kalviainen proof.
This file does not claim authorship of the construction or its proof. -/

namespace JSP183Replay

/-- The displayed witness has infinitely many distinct vertices. -/
theorem taggedLift_injective : Function.Injective Hilbert193.taggedLift := by
  intro m n h
  apply Hilbert193.taggedHeight_strictMono.injective
  have hz := congrArg Hilbert193.Point3.z h
  simpa only [Hilbert193.taggedLift, Nat.cast_inj] using hz

/-- Re-expose the original theorem without adding mathematical hypotheses. -/
theorem original_statement :
    ∃ (S : Set Hilbert193.Point3) (P : ℕ → Hilbert193.Point3),
      S.Finite ∧
      (∀ n, Hilbert193.displacement (P n) (P (n + 1)) ∈ S) ∧
      (∀ ⦃i j k⦄, i < j → j < k →
        ¬ Hilbert193.OrderedCollinear (P i) (P j) (P k)) :=
  Hilbert193.erdos193_unconditional

#print axioms taggedLift_injective
#print axioms original_statement
#print axioms Hilbert193.erdos193_unconditional
#print axioms Hilbert193.taggedLift_no_three
#print axioms Hilbert193.tagged_pair_law
#print axioms Hilbert193.gaussian_same_state_pair_law

end JSP183Replay

records.audit_source:
import ErdosProblems.Erdos346

/- Local audit wrapper; the mathematical proofs remain unchanged upstream. -/
namespace JSP288Audit

/-- The convergence-from-hypotheses reading recorded in JSP-000288. -/
def CatalogClaim : Prop :=
  ∀ a : ℕ → ℕ, StrictMono a → (∀ n, 0 < a n) →
    (∀ D : Set ℕ, D.Finite →
      ∃ H, ∀ n, H ≤ n → n ∈ Erdos346.subsetSums a Dᶜ) →
    (∀ D : Set ℕ, D.Infinite →
      ∀ H, ∃ n, H ≤ n ∧ n ∉ Erdos346.subsetSums a Dᶜ) →
    (∃ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε ∧ ∀ n, 1 + ε ≤ (a (n + 1) : ℝ) / a n) →
    Filter.Tendsto (fun n => (a (n + 1) : ℝ) / a n) Filter.atTop
      (nhds Real.goldenRatio)

/-- Audit glue only: all mathematical work is the attributed upstream proof. -/
theorem catalog_claim_false : ¬ CatalogClaim := Erdos346.not_erdos_346

end JSP288Audit
